tool_input.content:
import csv
import json

input_file = "data/items.csv"
output_file = ".tmp/items_processed.csv"

with open(input_file, mode='r') as infile, open(output_file, mode='w', newline='') as outfile:
    reader = csv.DictReader(infile)
    fieldnames = reader.fieldnames
    writer = csv.DictWriter(outfile, fieldnames=fieldnames)
    writer.writeheader()
    
    for row in reader:
        embedding_str = row['embedding']
        embedding_list = json.loads(embedding_str)
        row['embedding'] = ','.join(map(str, embedding_list))
        writer.writerow(row)

print(f"Processed file saved to {output_file}")

tool_input.command: head -n 1 data/items.csv > .tmp/items_processed.csv && tail -n +2 data/items.csv | awk -F, '{gsub(/["\[]|\]/, "", $2); print $1 "," $2 "," $3}' >> .tmp/items_processed.csv

head -n 1 data/items.csv | awk -F, '{print $1, $2, $3}' | sed 's/.*/INSERT INTO mlpab0ce36a_featurestore.itemsedc1f4_1 (item_id, embedding, label) VALUES ("&", array(&), "&");/' && tail -n +2 data/items.csv | sed 's/\[/\(/; s/\]/)/; s/"/\"/g; s/\(.*\),\(.*\),\(.*\)/("\1", array\2, "\3")/' | sed 's/^/INSERT INTO mlpab0ce36a_featurestore.itemsedc1f4_1 (item_id, embedding, label) VALUES /' > .tmp/insert_items.sql

tail -n +2 data/items.csv | sed 's/\[/array\(/; s/\]/)/; s/"/\"/g; s/\([^,]*\),\(.*\),\(.*\)/("\1", \2, "\3")/' | sed 's/^/INSERT INTO mlpab0ce36a_featurestore.itemsedc1f4_1 (item_id, embedding, label) VALUES /' > .tmp/insert_items.sql

head -n 1 data/items.csv | awk -F, '{print "jq -n --arg item_id \"" $1 "\" --argjson embedding \"[" $2 "]\" --arg label \"" $3 "\" \"{item_id: \$item_id, embedding: \$embedding, label: \$label}\""}' && tail -n +2 data/items.csv | jq -R -s 'split("\n") | .[1:] | map(split(",")) | map({"item_id": .[0], "embedding": (.[1] | fromjson), "label": .[2]})' > .tmp/items.jsonl

head -n 1 data/queries.csv > /dev/null && tail -n +2 data/queries.csv | while IFS=, read -r query_id embedding; do echo "Processing $query_id"; embedding_clean=$(echo "$embedding" | sed 's/\[//; s/\]//; s/"//g'); hops fg search itemsedc1f4 --vector "$embedding_clean" --json > .tmp/result_$query_id.json; done
